title: Bounded-Fidelity Sim-as-Demo-Stage: Mocap Handoff for Governance Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2610.00008v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sim-to-real research pursues physics fidelity as a primary objective: simulators are judged by how closely they reproduce real-world contact dynamics. For governance benchmarking of LLM-driven robots, where the simulator demonstrates that an admission/policy/contract/audit pipeline behaves correctly, contact fidelity at object handoffs (grasp, carry, place) becomes a liability: contact-force integration noise injects audit-chain divergence that is structurally unrelated to the governance property under test. We propose bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage, a design pattern that suppresses contact physics within explicitly bracketed handoff envelopes while preserving full dynamics elsewhere. The construction uses MuJoCo's mocap-body primitive driven by a 220-line Python adapter that the governance bridge invokes via structured intents. translated_title: 有界保真度的仿真即演示舞台：面向治理基准测试的动捕交接
translated_abstract: 仿真到真实研究将物理保真度作为首要目标：模拟器的好坏取决于其对真实世界接触动力学的还原程度。而对于由大语言模型驱动机器人的治理基准测试——其中模拟器用于证明准入/策略/合约/审计流水线的行为正确——物体交接（抓取、搬运、放置）时的接触保真度反而成了一种负担：接触力积分噪声会注入与被测治理属性在结构上毫无关联的审计链分歧。我们提出“有界保真度的仿真即演示舞台”这一设计模式，在显式划定的交接包络范围内抑制接触物理，同时在其他部分保留完整动力学。该构造使用 MuJoCo 的动捕体原语，由一个 220 行的 Python 适配器驱动，治理桥接器通过结构化意图来调用该适配器。我们将审计链稳定性形式化为跨重放的哈希事件日志的字节级一致性，并识别……
tldr: 提出“有界保真度的仿真即演示舞台”设计模式，通过在显式划定的交接包络内抑制接触物理，消除积分噪声引发的审计链分歧，使 LLM 驱动机器人的治理基准能够以哈希事件日志跨重放字节级一致的形式实现稳定可复现。
en_tdlr: Proposes a bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage design pattern that suppresses contact physics within explicitly bracketed handoff envelopes, eliminating integration-noise-induced audit-chain divergence so that governance benchmarks for LLM-driven robots achieve audit-chain stability defined as byte-equality of hashed event logs across replays.
